projects.title: Power System Monitoring & Safety Device
projects.description: ESP32-based power monitoring and safety device with OLED display, Blynk IoT integration, and automated hybrid cloud logging to Google Sheets.
projects.details: Professional-grade embedded system that monitors live power parameters and triggers safety responses. Features real-time OLED readout, remote Blynk dashboard, and automated Google Sheets cloud logging. Implemented in C++ as a final year project.

projects.title: Rice Quality Detection – ESP32-CAM + YOLOv8
projects.description: Real-time rice quality detection system using ESP32-CAM and YOLOv8 object detection to automatically identify and sort defective rice grains.
projects.details: Combines edge AI with embedded vision. The ESP32-CAM streams live footage to a YOLOv8 model that classifies and sorts defective rice grains in real time. Implemented in C++ with custom inference pipeline integration on resource-constrained hardware.

projects.title: Electromagnetic Wave-Based Wireless Charging for EVs
projects.description: Comprehensive design and simulation study of a wireless power transfer (WPT) system for electric vehicle charging applications.
projects.details: Final year project exploring electromagnetic wave-based wireless power transfer for EVs. Built using Python for simulation and analysis, focusing on WPT coil design, efficiency optimization, and system modelling. Published in the Global Journal of Energy Technology Research Updates, Vol. 12.

projects.title: Electrical Fault Analysis & Classification
projects.description: Hybrid CNN-LSTM deep learning model for electrical fault classification in power transmission lines, achieving 78% accuracy across 6 fault types.
projects.details: Implements a time-series deep learning pipeline using a CNN-LSTM hybrid architecture. Classifies 6 types of electrical transmission faults. Includes complete ML pipeline: data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and visualisation. Built in Python.

projects.title: STDR Fault Detection on 3-Phase Power Lines
projects.description: MATLAB/Simulink modelled Sequence Time Domain Reflectometry (STDR) system for detecting and locating faults on 3-phase power transmission lines.
projects.details: Modelled in MATLAB/Simulink with a custom 3-phase channel model. Supports selective fault injection (Line-to-Ground, Short Circuit, Open Circuit) at arbitrary distances. Includes a Python-based post-processing pipeline for generating thesis-quality publication plots and performance tables.

projects.title: Optimal Sizing of a Hybrid Microgrid using PSO
projects.description: MATLAB/Simulink simulation for the optimal sizing and economic analysis of a hybrid renewable energy microgrid utilizing Particle Swarm Optimization.
projects.details: Modelled in MATLAB/Simulink integrating Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage systems, and a Diesel Generator. The project leverages a Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to determine optimal capacity configurations that minimize annualized financial costs while strictly enforcing strict power reliability limits (LPSP).

projects.title: Kalman Filter-Based Cyber-Attack Detection in DC Microgrids
projects.description: A MATLAB/Simulink framework for rapidly identifying and mitigating False Data Injection cyber-attacks targeting telemetry and data integrity in DC Microgrids.
projects.details: Modelled in MATLAB/Simulink integrating a physical plant of a DC Microgrid with a Stateflow logic detector. The project leverages a Kalman Filter state estimator to track actual sensor parameters continuously versus computational equations. It features an automated dynamic thresholding algorithm to ensure sub-millisecond detection latency without triggering false positives from ambient system noise.

projects.title: VoltSentry – US Power Grid Stress Intelligence
projects.description: MCP tool for real-time US power grid stress analysis using NERC's Severity Risk Index (SRI) as the unbundling target.
projects.details: Developed as a CTX Protocol developer grant submission. Ingests NERC SRI data to surface grid stress intelligence, enabling proactive grid management decisions. Resubmitted with strategic reframing after initial reviewer feedback.

projects.title: Arduino Codes for Beginners
projects.description: A curated collection of Arduino and ESP32 sketches covering basics, IoT with Arduino Cloud, and web server implementation.
projects.details: Organized into four learning tracks: Basic Learning, IoT with Arduino Cloud, Projects & Experiments, and Web Server on ESP32. A companion resource for DeeThunderNexus students learning embedded systems from scratch.

projects.title: 3-in-1 Smart Power Bank
projects.description: IoT-enabled smart power bank with 5V/12V regulated outputs, cloud monitoring, and QR-based device provisioning.
projects.details: Built around the ESP32-C3 with INA219 current sensing, LM2596 (5V) and XL6009 (12V) DC-DC converters, and a 3S BMS. Cloud backend powered by Node.js on Railway, MongoDB Atlas, and a Next.js dashboard on Vercel. Features AES-256 QR device linking, Socket.io real-time telemetry, and captive portal WiFi provisioning.
